title: Prediction
description: Distinguish effect logic from event logic.
prompt: Which job is a good fit for useEffect?

options.label: Submitting a form because the user clicked Submit.
Calculating a button label from current state.
Updating document.title after the rendered lesson title changes.

responses.click-submit: Not quite. A submit caused by a user action belongs in the event handler.
responses.derive-label: Not quite. Derived UI text belongs in render, not in an effect.
responses.document-title: Correct. The browser tab title is outside React, so an effect can synchronize it after render.

metadata.reason: Catches overusing effects for event handlers and derived UI state.
